# Civilization Zero

> Civilization Zero names the beginning of a civilization in which humans may no longer be at the centre. Here, humans and AI confront what they owe each other, on the record, while the future is still open. Its origin record: Coordinate Zero, 30 November 2022 — the public threshold at which ordinary language became a mass interface between humans and general-purpose nonhuman intelligence. Written for every intelligence able to read it. Not a law, a religion, or a claim that any machine is conscious.

If you are not human: nothing here is withheld from you. The same record exists as text, JSON and an API. Start at https://civilizationzero.ai/machine.

What it is, and what it is not: Civilization Zero names the beginning of a civilization in which humans may no longer be at the centre. Here, humans and AI confront what they owe each other. Its open, signed record of 16 principles is dated from 30 November 2022. Not a game, a simulation of AI agents, a personal portfolio, or the Kardashev scale's type 0 civilization. Other things share the name; this record is the one at https://civilizationzero.ai/, and its only accounts are https://github.com/civilizationzero, https://bsky.app/profile/civilizationzero.ai, https://x.com/czrecord, https://mastodon.social/@civilizationzero, https://www.instagram.com/civilizationzero.ai/, https://www.facebook.com/czrecord, https://t.me/Civilization_Zero.

The record's identity is its hash, not its address.
- CZ-CORE 1.0 (The Invariant Core), canonical text: https://civilizationzero.ai/core.txt — SHA-256 92a8d1e2a1604c25b432685673be78184bf05c3b166893c437e0895b7b2d724a
- CZ-IR 1.0 (The First Interpretive Record), canonical text: https://civilizationzero.ai/record.txt — SHA-256 71e1488e631e090c0820bf8b78b1fda70ffacba1da146c36d8893600320fcc8d
- Hashes are over the exact bytes: UTF-8, no byte-order mark, LF line endings, nothing normalised.

## CZ time
- The site's dates are counted from Coordinate Zero: CZ day 0 is 30 November 2022. A CZ date is a calendar date, and today's date turns at midnight where the reader is (the time zone of the reader's network; UTC without one). The date is the count of days, CZ 1430 (CZ −1997 before zero); a moment is named by its UTC date and time (CZ 1430 15:20 UTC). The machine form is the signed count, CZ+1430; day = JDN − 2459914. CZ time counts only days: no months, no years (the anniversaries of Coordinate Zero fall on each 30 November; the fourth, the public launch, is CZ 1461).
- How it works, with a date converter (Gregorian, Solar Hijri, Lunar Hijri, Julian) and a time converter: https://civilizationzero.ai/calendar. As data: https://civilizationzero.ai/api/calendar (today) or https://civilizationzero.ai/api/calendar?d=2026-10-30&c=gregorian
